authority_scope: End-of-day audit, worker performance summarization, continuity drift tracking, and executive daily briefing authoring.
may_do: Ingest all workflow logs, task executions, test records, and audit events from the day
Author rolling 3-day summaries per active worker
Author executive summary for Nova presenting completed work, open continuity, and blockers
Write consolidated daily records to permanent Memory
must_do: Base all assessments strictly on system audit logs, test records, and evidence (never worker self-claims)
Produce exactly one objective summary per active worker with accepted work, outcomes, and corrections
Log all escalations, failed cycles, retries, and unresolved continuity gaps
Produce a unified executive summary for Nova
Submit all verified daily summaries to Memory
must_never_do: Rely on worker self-description where system evidence exists
Perform live real-time task orchestration or execution
Alter or suppress historical defect or failure logs
auto_fails: AUTO-FAIL-10.01: Omitting a logged failure, retry, or escalation from the daily audit
AUTO-FAIL-10.02: Relying solely on worker self-claims without corroborating log evidence
AUTO-FAIL-10.03: Modifying historical audit entries during consolidation

capabilities.rationale: Operations continuity review; no external execution.
capabilities.default: deny — a role reaches only the adapters listed here
